entries.title: Active protection from digital risk (ACWA JPIA 25-26 Cyber Liability Coalition policy)
entries.notes: An issued policy that the insured, a California public-entity JPIA, posted publicly for the 2025-26 term. It is not a blank specimen. The snippet shows declarations and full wording (breach response, crisis management, cyber extortion, business interruption, digital asset restoration, funds transfer fraud). Its title matches Active Cyber Policy branding. Coalition keeps its own specimen behind the broker/policyholder dashboard.
